title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1966-07-03
source: flac16/48kHz; Source Info: Master Soundboard 10" Reel @15ips 1/2trk > Dat (16/48); Transfer Info: Sony PCM-R500 (16/48) > Tascam DA-3000 > Adobe Audition > TLH flac1648

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard capture of a summer‑66 set with Viola Lee Blues, Big Boss Man and Pigpen’s organ, offering excellent clarity despite occasional dropouts.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers a clear, well‑balanced soundboard mix that showcases the early Summer ’66 vibe – psychedelic pop jams, sweet guitar licks and Pigpen on organ. Reviewers love the standout performances of Viola Lee Blues, Big Boss Man, Sittin’ On Top Of The World, Don’t Ease Me In and Stealin’, though one notes a few drops and missing sections in the tape.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise both the music and the crisp soundboard, with only minor complaints about occasional dropouts; this yields a strong combined show (≈4.6) and recording (≈4.2) rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally crisp and well‑balanced SBD, but some reviewers report drops, cuts and missing portions in parts of the tape.

standout_songs: Sittin’ On Top Of The World
show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑summer 1966 set blends blues numbers with emerging psychedelic pop, delivering solid jams and a lively atmosphere despite the show’s “rudimentary” pre‑Primal character.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Sweet guitar licks noted by reviewers, contributing to the jam feel.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s organ work highlighted as a key texture on this early show.
